title: Do State Phone Bans at School Really Improve Student Performance?
text: Figure 1: Model-predicted proficiency rates before and after cell phone bans for Louisiana (warm colors) and South Carolina (cold colors) across subjects.

title: Do State Phone Bans at School Really Improve Student Performance?
text:
Project Overview
In recent years, several states have enacted statewide restrictions on student cell phone usage during school hours. This website looks into the empirical effect of these policies on student academic performance, focusing on standardized test results in Louisiana (LEAP 2025 assessments) and South Carolina (SC READY assessments).
